verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents event-triggered flows: merchants can set up flows based on Klaviyo events to send notifications automatically (klaviyo-docs-17). Automation building is included even on the free plan (klaviyo-docs-19), and custom events can be sent in via API to feed those triggers (klaviyo-docs-30). Missing for 10: detailed docs on rule and condition logic (filters, branching, delays), clear evidence of webhook actions fired by events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
